issue-4201: Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on m

args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured public application URL from `config.app.publicUrl` (or equivalent config property) instead of falling back to localhost when `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is unset, ensuring password reset emails link to the correct domain in production.
args.title: Use configured public URL for password reset email links
